patterns.note: Content is presented in full-width sections with a consistent maximum width for text and interactive elements, typically centered, creating a focused reading experience against varied backgrounds.

Section headings are large, bold, and sans-serif, providing strong visual hierarchy, while body text is smaller and highly legible. Uppercase subheadings are used for emphasis and to introduce sections or categories.

A high-contrast palette features deep black or dark grey backgrounds with white text, vibrantly accented by product-specific colors and a distinct, bright lime green for calls-to-action and interactive elements.

The hero section features a large product image that parallaxes slowly against the scroll, creating a sense of depth and drawing attention to the product. Subsequent content sections reveal with a subtle fade-up and slight upward translation as they enter the viewport.
Product variations are presented in a horizontally scrollable grid, allowing users to browse different flavors or types without leaving the current section, enhancing discoverability.

technique_notes: The site employs a scroll-triggered animation system, likely using locomotive-scroll as hinted, to create a smooth parallax effect on the hero image where the background moves slower than the foreground content. This system also orchestrates staggered fade-in and subtle upward slide animations for content blocks as they become visible in the viewport.
Interactive elements like product cards and buttons utilize subtle hover states, such as a slight lift or a change in background color, to provide visual feedback and indicate interactivity.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, impactful display headings (~4-5x body text) with a modern, clean sans-serif character, complemented by smaller, highly legible sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) on buttons, cards, and input fields, providing a soft, modern feel without being overly rounded.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, while product grids maintain a more structured, slightly denser arrangement.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, almost black background combined with vibrant, almost neon product photography and a specific, bright lime green accent creates a luxurious yet playful aesthetic. The seamless integration of product imagery into the overall design, often as full-bleed elements or background textures, makes the products feel central and highly desirable.
